finding: Choosing the weight exponent INSIDE the training fold (so no tuning touches the test fold) gives 0.6314, only 0.0025 below the fixed p=0.5 value. The selected exponents cluster at 0.5-0.65, which confirms 0.5 is a reasonable prior rather than a lucky pick. This closes the last 'did you tune on the test set' objection.
note: selected_p counts exceed the 10 outer seeds because the distribution was collected over 15 inner selections.
